basics.name: Kyle M. Anderson
basics.summary: Technical professional with experience migrating production workloads to AWS, leading tax-integration platform development, and automating manual work. Combines software development and systems integration with implementation support, troubleshooting, project coordination, and technical documentation.

work.name: DSTax Technologies
work.summary: Technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, with responsibilities spanning development, project coordination, client support, troubleshooting, and documentation.
highlights: Migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS.
Led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform.
Optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput.
Developed integrations between financial platforms and tax providers, broadening platform and provider support.
Supported end-to-end integration implementations, including requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live support.
Managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, communicating integration updates, reporting status, and responding to questions and requests.
Created and maintained client integration guides and knowledge-base articles.

work.name: Colectivo Coffee Roasters
highlights: Partnered with the IT department to install and troubleshoot new point-of-sale nodes.

work.name: Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global)
highlights: Initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work.
Evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers.
Managed SharePoint sites and data and designed data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and promote cross-department information sharing.
